purpose: Single machine-readable index for worthy post-v15.5 candidates so design work is not stranded in chats, issues, branches or implementation-only work packages.

candidate_groups.summary: Nine source-design gap closures: bootstrap trust root, shared-state authority provenance, deterministic let/query semantics, causal-level typing, R0 SanityGate separation, rights-view ordering, provenance redaction-vs-absence manifest, and catalogue closure for AuthorityDecl/EffectDecl.

Continuous runtime epistemic assimilation, lineage-aware corroboration, loss-aware distillation, separately governed model consolidation and knowledge-dividend accounting without authority amplification.

Bounded historical-chat audit preserving only distinct residuals after whole-source comparison: cross-scale causal discovery, behavioral/normative/mechanism drift audit, Human Assurance Reliability/HITL workload profile, UCAS and Kindergarten definition recovery, SCEP implementation lineage, fuller justice scope, and outcome-based KR memory evaluation.

Literal ChatGPT/DeepSeek/Gemini export audit preserves five residuals not already explicit enough in v15.5 or prior recovery: hazard-monotonic emergency selection, scoped unsafe-region/infeasibility memory, adversarial precedent revalidation refinement, change-complexity/assurance-burden accounting, and temporal authority snapshot/anti-retroactive authorization binding.

Define GAIA as 'Garden Artificial Intelligence Architecture' for GAIA Titanium and GAIA Diamond. This is a terminology clarification only; it does not change GAIA behavior, safety/assurance contracts, authority or topology.

Emergency-source independence normalization, typed consent-validity assessment, external regression bundle, and ConstitutionalEvent typed-boundary/observability hardening. Must be reconciled into the private candidate materialization before any daily successor release.

Tiered SectionUnit review, delta-dependency scheduling, lineage-aware reviewer diversity, explicit E0-E4 evidence classes, shadow/mirror implementation validation, MoveEquivalenceClaim, PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR successor classes, human-availability continuity, governed rollback, ProcessVersion binding, LIGHT non-semantic track and configuration-surface coupling.

Refines process v1.0 with immutable producer evidence classes, non-blocking symmetric delta relations, typed rollback-candidate triggers, denominator-bound incremental Tier-A resweeps, a permanent-unavailability admitted-delta cap, scheduled protocol simplification, and first-class release milestones.

Earlier Rationalization & Verification Hardening / ReasoningStrategyPortfolio proposal was recorded as a ratified design proposal with machine/empirical certification pending. Do not silently drop it: compare against v15.5 Reason/GSL-COMPARE/AAP/verification owners and either mark fully subsumed with evidence or requeue only surviving semantic gaps.
candidate_groups.admission_boundary: No assumption that the historical proposal is still needed in full; reconciliation must prefer existing v15.5 owners and NO_CHANGE where already covered.

daily_materialization_rule: A daily successor candidate may include only deltas that have passed the required >=3 effective independent same-target reviewer families with blind-first review, peer cross-examination, immutable producer-assigned evidence classes and challenge handling, whole-source GSL-COMPARE/reason/proof/evidence, directional dependency consistency, symmetric shared-surface revalidation, cross-delta consistency, reference closure and exact predecessor-retention checks.
